IMOLD Srl has more than 20 years of experience in the field of production and manufacturing of precision mechanics, in particular injection molding dies. IMOLD Srl combines this long and solid experience with the continuous development of production processes and its skills in various areas of mechanical design and manufacturing.
Although classified as a "micro enterprise," the continuous research activity and vocation in industrial innovation allow Imold srl to be well integrated in research contexts with various academic collaborations and successful participation in competitive calls for industrial innovation.

The activities of Imold srl are marked by specific R&D projects that are carried out on customer orders up to the realization of equipment for mass production (injection molding dies) and production itself.
There are numerous sectors of industrial production in which Imold, on behalf of its clients, conducts and implements projects concerning new products: medical and biomedical, electronics, food, automotive.
R&D activities, carried out on order, include Imold srl's collaboration with INFN to make substrates for LASA photocathodes, CERN experiments, DESY and FERMILAB.
Imold srl has also realized with its own project, for an innovative startup, the prototype of a mobile device with a robotic arm for positioning a stereoscopic camera on the patient during cardiac surgery.
Over the years, the R&D department of Imold srl has developed the entire infrastructure of its own flexible robotic cell, including the control and management software (based on ROS), which is currently used in mold production.
Imold’s R&D department has expertise in mechanical design, industrial automation, mechatronics and CNC programming.
Imold is currently engaged in its own research topics concerning vision systems, AI, robotics.

entityDescription:
PLOATECH specializes in advanced scientific and customized engineering services, with a primary focus on the underwater domain. Our expertise spans in the following key sectors: remote sensing, data processing, instrumentation R&D, and robotics.
Data services include organizing and conducting survey operations with manned and/or robotic vehicles; real-time and post-processing 3D spatial measurements of the seafloor and water column, including temporal and multi-parametric data. Instrumentation R&D includes automations, scientific sensors, and systems integration. In addition, development and improvements of human-occupied submersibles, remotely operated vehicles (ROVs) and autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs).

PLOATECH works to provide scientists with tools for detection and measurements, for helping improve the environmental conditions of the seas and oceans. To this end and although PLOATECH is a relatively new company, it draws over 25 years of experience in the marine scientific sector, and our track record includes participation in oceanographic expeditions and research projects funded by organizations such as H2020, NSF, NASA, and NOPP.
Space programs can directly benefit from technologies used for sea surface and underwater environments, either for data validation (ground truth) or as testbed for exploration in other ocean worlds. PLOATECH’s R&D is relevant to ESA because it decreases the need for human intervention in complex or hazardous environments which have previously required human teleoperation of highly manoeuvrable vehicles and emphasizes minimalist hardware through increased reliance on autonomous analysis, navigation, and planning. This is directly transferable to planetary explorers which must operate under similar power, size, and telemetry constraints.
PLOATECH stands at the forefront of underwater engineering science. Our commitment to sustainability, cutting-edge technology, and cross-disciplinary collaboration drives our mission as we are contributing to the exploration of the depths of the oceans.

SkyWatch, a Canadian SME, that specializes in Earth observation (EO) data and the support of analytics, both through its state-of-the-art cloud-based software Platform. SkyWatch delivers pioneering solutions for both downstream and upstream space markets, focusing on the strategic needs of end users and customers. The Platform streamlines access to a comprehensive aggregation of satellite and aerial imagery, enabling rapid, on-demand processing and analysis, supporting applications requiring timely and accurate EO data - supporting dual-use applications. 
For the downstream, SkyWatch offers unparalleled ease in accessing and integrating EO data, supported by a scalable infrastructure and a robust API for seamless system integration. Since 2018, the Platform has gained traction with over 5,000 commercial organizations globally, evidencing its reliability and efficiency with over 1 million API calls per month, while offering its users to over 90% of commercially available satellite-based EO data. Additionally, SkyWatch specializes in the streamlined ingestion and integration of geospatial data products into any Esri environment or application. 
For the upstream, SkyWatch provides a tailored solution for satellite operators, facilitating efficient data management and monetization through a framework for creating data pipelines, while automating the entire process of data ingestion, processing, and distribution. The Platform excels in high-volume data processing and supports the integration of machine learning and AI models, resulting in less waste and lower costs for operators. The Platform leverages market intelligence from the downstream, creating tactical and strategic benefits for operators to optimize collections, plan orbits, engage in speculative tasking, and increase fulfillment. 
Over the past 10 years of operation, we've developed have a strong set of competences around multi-sensor integration, orchestration, data management & storage, and delivery to workflows that benefits our private commercial customer base, while also engaging with the Canadian Space Agency (CSA) and the European Space Agency (ESA) on key strategic R&D projects.
